_comment: CORS for the SELAH backgrounds bucket.
The verse card is drawn into a <canvas> and exported with toBlob(). A
cross-origin image drawn without CORS taints that canvas and toBlob()
throws a SecurityError at the moment the user taps Share. The card
therefore loads the background with crossOrigin='anonymous', and that
request only succeeds if the bucket returns these headers.
Without this rule nothing breaks visibly — the image just fails to load
and every card falls back to the gradient. That is the symptom to look
for if backgrounds exist in Firebase but never appear on a card.
Apply:  gcloud storage buckets update gs://YOUR_BUCKET --cors-file=deploy/firebase/cors.json
